figurative_meaning_en: To become mentally disturbed or unsettled
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে আমার মন টলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing his words, my mind wavered.
It's natural for the mind to waver upon seeing beauty.
history: Often references folklore tales where even sages (muni) have their minds disturbed by beauty, drawing from ancient Indian ascetic stories.
note: The idiom highlights the fragility of mental resolve in Bengali expressive language.
